description: Gujarat implements AI grain analysers at MSP centres to enhance paddy quality assessment, ensuring transparency and efficiency in procurement.
body_lead: Gujarat has begun using artificial intelligence to test the quality of paddy procured from farmers under the Minimum Support Price (MSP) scheme, with an AI-based grain analyser deployed at 10 procurement centres across four districts. The pilot, implemented during the Kharif Marketing Season (KMS) 2025-26, analysed 6,191 paddy samples. Of these, 3,379 samples, or 54.6 per cent, were classified as Grade A, while 2,812 samples (45.4 per cent) were classified as Common. A total of 341 samples were rejected, according to the Gujarat State Civil Supplies Corporation.
